caption: Modernitätsgrad1 des öffentlichen Kapitalstocks, 1991 bis 2023
model_annotation: The diagram compares the modernity level of various categories of public capital stock from 1991 to 2023. The x-axis represents the years, ranging from 1991 to 2023 with tick labels at every two years, and is labeled with the years in a linear scale. The y-axis represents the percentage, ranging from 45% to 70% with tick labels at every 5% interval. The diagram displays five distinct lines, each corresponding to a different category: "Wohnbauten" (residential buildings) in maroon, "Hochbau" (high-rise construction) in blue, "Tiefbau" (civil engineering) in green, "Ausrüstungen" (equipment) in gray, and "Geistiges Eigentum" (intellectual property) in light purple, along with a dashed black line representing "Staat insgesamt" (total public sector). The maroon line starts at around 68% in 1991, decreases to around 47% in 2007, and then fluctuates, ending at around 54% in 2023. The blue line begins at approximately 66% in 1991 and declines to around 47% in 2023. The green line commences at about 63% in 1991, decreases to around 54% in 2005, and then remains relatively stable, ending at around 53% in 2023. The gray line starts at around 54% in 1991, drops to around 50% in 2003, and then rises to around 57% in 2023. The light purple line begins at approximately 51% in 1991, decreases to around 50% in 2003, and then increases to around 54% in 2023. The dashed black line representing "Staat insgesamt" starts at approximately 62% in 1991 and gradually declines to around 52% in 2023.
